entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I dunno... The ocean just looks kinda[n]bland to me...
Feel better.
Just give up.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't say that like I'm the only one who[n]messed up! We were goin' at it as a team,[n]right!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, it ain't over yet! I'm goin' for a[n]miracle comeback!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm... Did someone follow us here?[n]Something tells me we're being[n]watched...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Really? You think... one of those girls[n]changed her mind?

entries.speaker: Deep Voice
entries.en: O-M-G. It's the golden boy himself!

entries.speaker: Brawny Voice
entries.en: And he's already got his own little[n]entourage! We really did teach[n]him right, didn't we?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You!? Oh no...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What are YOU guys doin' here!?

entries.speaker: Angel
entries.en: Sometimes we just gotta get out of the[n]city! Forget the nightlife, breathe fresh[n]air, enjoy some eye candy...

entries.speaker: Julian
entries.en: We thought we'd lost our protégé! Who[n]would've guessed our vaycay was[n]actually the call of fate?

entries.speaker: Angel
entries.en: Aw, what's with the look? Don't believe in[n]fate? Or did you really not have fun last[n]time?

entries.speaker: Julian
entries.en: You gonna tell us you saw yourself in all[n]that chiffon and felt nothing?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I-I don't think I felt what you guys were[n]hopin'...

entries.speaker: Angel
entries.en: Aw, honey, I get it. Everyone's nervous[n]when they first start out, but trust me.

entries.speaker: Angel
entries.en: You'll make their jaws drop!

entries.speaker: Julian
entries.en: Just an hour at the vanity, three hours at[n]the boutique, and we can just pick up[n]where we left off last time.

entries.speaker: Julian
entries.en: So... are you ready to steal some hearts?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, we gotta go! Sorry!

entries.speaker: Julian
entries.en: Was it something I said...? Ugh, what a [n]tragedy. Another starlet slips through [n]our fingers.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh! No! No more makeovers! Ughhh!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: By the way, where's Yusuke?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So this is where you two were.[n]I've been searching for you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, what're you doin' with those[n]lobsters?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: While you were busy with your[n]interrogation, I found these[n]beautiful specimens on sale.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And so, I decided to spend the last[n]of my money on them.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, you're real hopeless when it[n]comes to cash...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, you were watchin' us!?[n]Why didn't you help!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Apologies, but I was entranced.[n]The moment I set eyes on this[n]distinct shape, I was in love.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I haven't had my very core shaken as[n]vigorously as this since the first time[n]Ann entered my gaze.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Good for you...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We're here with friends.

entries.speaker: Pretentious Man
entries.en: C'mon, don't lie to us, baby.

entries.speaker: Pretentious Man
entries.en: How about you come for a nice cruise[n]on our boat?

entries.speaker: Wealthy-Looking Man
entries.en: There's going to be a party too.[n]Tons of celebrities and industry[n]people will be coming along.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Are you even listening to us!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sorry 'bout the wait.

entries.speaker: Pretentious Man
entries.en: Huh, so you were serious about[n]being here with friends.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's what we've been saying[n]from the start!

entries.speaker: Wealthy-Looking Man
entries.en: Don't you find it boring spending[n]your time with kids like them?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's far more interesting than[n]anything involving you two.

entries.speaker: Pretentious Man
entries.en: What was that?

entries.speaker: Wealthy-Looking Man
entries.en: Hey, let's just let the children[n]have fun with fellow children.

entries.speaker: Wealthy-Looking Man
entries.en: We'll be going now!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What creeps...!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thanks for coming in like that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Those guys just wouldn't stop[n]pestering us.
You did well to hold them off.
They got lucky.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: To be honest, I was nearly at my wits' end.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What do you mean?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If things'd gone bad, you would've[n]just sent 'em to the hospita—

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: U-Uhhh... never mind. It's nothing.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: By the way, where are Futaba and[n]Morgana?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Ooooh! Are those lobsters? One in[n]each hand!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I was wondering about that myself.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Are you going to make them into sashimi?[n]Or perhaps roast them whole!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Enough of your vile postulations![n]These are purely for the sake of[n]visual appreciation!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We did tons of stuff today. All in all,[n]I guess comin' to the beach was pretty[n]worth it!
